## Open Question (non-blocking)

[LOW] Handle unguessability oracle is inspection-level, not black-box
Requirement/task: R7 / AC14 — Confidence: LOW
The enforced AC14 oracle (pairwise-distinct, content-independent, session-independent) cannot by itself distinguish a counter or a time-seeded PRNG from `crypto/rand`, since those also satisfy all three; the spec is honest that "distinctness is necessary, not sufficient" and demotes `crypto/rand` to an inspection-verified advisory. Observable consequence: an implementation switching to a weak-but-non-derived generator would pass all runtime tests and be caught only by code review. This is already surfaced and mitigated by the advisory marker, so it does not block.
